prompt: A single illustration depicts a large, glowing AI chip labeled "High-End Accelerator – License Required" being held up at a customs checkpoint formed by a border wall, where a guard consults a specification sheet listing a processing-speed threshold; but in the lower corner of the same wall, a gap shows a smaller, consumer-grade chip labeled "Below Threshold – No License" slipping through, carried down a winding chain of silhouetted middlemen (distributor, reseller, reseller) whose arrows fade and fork across a dim world map, finally reaching a military installation in a restricted country, with the original licensed chip still stuck behind the checkpoint, visually demonstrating that measurable technical cutoffs leave legal loopholes and multi-step resale chains make post-sale tracking nearly impossible, so the wall shapes but does not seal the supply route.
